description: Write or edit a bot's BOT.md from the template, then hand the check to /doctor:bots. :auto/:confirm.
gate3_location: bots/<bot-id>/BOT.md in the consumer repository named by --repo

userIntent.job: I want to write or change a bot definition and know it passes the checker before anything runs it.

choreography.action: load the system-skilled-bots parent hub routing table
load the author mode contract, then apply its workflow to $ARGUMENTS
load the presentation contract before showing any setup question or result

discriminator.whenToUse: The request names the author mode of a file-defined bot.

preferSiblingWhen.when: The BOT.md already passes the checker and the request is to run it.

description: Start a bot run, queue or drain bot run requests, or answer a needs-you item. :auto/:confirm.
gate3_location: the run record under the user-level state root, and the consumer checkout when a shared-isolation run edits files

userIntent.job: I want a bot to run now, from the queue, or after I answer its question.

choreography.action: load the system-skilled-bots parent hub routing table
load the run mode contract, then apply its workflow to $ARGUMENTS
load the presentation contract before showing any setup question or result

discriminator.whenToUse: The request names the run mode of a file-defined bot.

preferSiblingWhen.when: The request only reads which items are open.

description: Install or remove a cron bot's launchd schedule, or enable, disable, pause or resume a bot. :auto/:confirm.
gate3_location: a launchd agent under ~/Library/LaunchAgents and control state under the user-level state root

userIntent.job: I want a cron bot on its launchd schedule, held or released, or taken off it.

choreography.action: load the system-skilled-bots parent hub routing table
load the schedule mode contract, then apply its workflow to $ARGUMENTS
load the presentation contract before showing any setup question or result

discriminator.whenToUse: The request names the schedule mode of a file-defined bot.

preferSiblingWhen.when: The request is one run now rather than a schedule.

description: Read installed bots, last runs, deliveries and the needs-you inbox. Read-only. :auto/:confirm.
gate3_location: n/a: reads only; --rebuild rewrites the status index under the user-level state root

userIntent.job: I want to see what my bots did and what they need from me, without changing anything.

choreography.action: load the system-skilled-bots parent hub routing table
load the status mode contract, then apply its workflow to $ARGUMENTS
load the presentation contract before showing any setup question or result

discriminator.whenToUse: The request names the status mode of a file-defined bot.

preferSiblingWhen.when: The request answers a needs-you item rather than reading it.
